plan.notes: TRUE DEGREE VERIFIED: SCCC does not offer an AS Computer Science (or AA in computing). Its official computing degree is the Computer Programming AAS (Associate in Applied Science), listed on the official program page at https://sunysullivan.edu/computer-science/computer-programming-aas/ and in SUNY's program listings as 'Computer Programming' (A). This plan uses the TRUE degree name; no silent substitution. SOURCE: official 2026-2027 Contract of Study 'Computer Programming - AAS' (degree plan link on the official program page), docx at https://sunysullivan.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Computer-Programming-AAS-2026-2027.docx. Transcription method: downloaded the docx 2026-09-30 and hand-transcribed every row from the 'Suggested Sequence of Full-Time Study' table; one row's text (CPT 2226 Object Oriented Programming, Fall Only, 3 cr, Third Semester) was hidden from python-docx cell extraction due to document markup and was recovered by reading the row's underlying XML directly. CREDIT DISCREPANCY: SCCC's printed degree total is '60-61 Credits' and the First Semester prints '15-16' because the First Semester math slot (MAT 1005, 1205, 1206, 1301 or higher) is 3-4 credits depending on the course selected. The plan records that slot at its 3-credit minimum, so the plan sums to the 60-credit published minimum; a student selecting a 4-credit math course earns 61. PREREQS: the official contract lists no per-course prerequisites, so all prereq arrays are empty rather than invented. GE outcome codes (DVRSTY, COMM, MATH, HUM/ARTS/LANG, WHGA/USHIS/SOCSC, NASCI) are transcribed from the contract's GE column into choice notes.
